title: Reporting Deadlines and Evidence Requirements of the Keyturn Shield Host Plans
content:
Each plan of the Keyturn Host Protection Plan publishes its own filing window in hours, its own evidence period in calendar days, and its own minimum number of photographs for a report.

| Plan | Filing window, hours | Evidence period, calendar days | Evidence minimum, photographs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 24 | 3 | 8 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 24 | 3 | 8 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 48 | 5 | 10 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 72 | 7 | 12 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 96 | 10 | 12 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 120 | 14 | 14 |

### Column by column

The filing window widens as the cover deepens, from 24 hours on the Keyturn Shield 90 and Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plans to 120 hours on the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan. The evidence period runs from 3 calendar days at the top of the ladder to 14 at the foot of it. The evidence minimum is 8 photographs on the Keyturn Shield 90 and 85 Host Plans, 10 on the Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan, 12 on the Keyturn Shield 75 and 70 Host Plans and 14 on the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan.

### Points of judgement

The three figures are published independently of one another: a plan with a generous filing window does not on that account publish a generous evidence period, as the Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan shows with 96 hours to file, 10 days of evidence period and an evidence minimum of 12.
